message.content: {"verdict":"CONCEPT_ONLY_UNQUALIFIED","source_grounded_constraints":["Integrated core; GPU overhang allowed. Repack all four independently serviceable external bays A–D into one continuous monolithic printed skeleton; do not append a fourth printed side module to the former three-bay body.","Conservative print bounding box: at most 200 x 188 x 254 mm in its selected print rotation. The solver must evaluate installed orientation and print rotation together; no fixed installed row prerequisite.","Printed pillars/rails themselves must stay within the print box; installed cards and outboard PSU may overhang.","Card D needs the core's own reinforced pillars/crossmembers and a qualified metal support rail where required. It must never rest on cards A–C, their shrouds/fans, or the PCIe connector. Rotate D's receiver/bracket datum 90 degrees with the card.","Model independent removal of every card, including whether lower cards can exit without removing D. Intake/exhaust direction and clear 12 mm gap are hard constraints.","Two 120 mm fan frames require 240 mm across the recovered fan wall; narrower/taller core needs re-solved fan placement. If 25 mm fan thickness and 25–35 mm plenum lie serially ahead of a 199 mm card, GPU/fan/plenum depth is 249–259 mm, requiring 49–59 mm installed rear projection beyond 200 D before other clearances.","Baseline: plain PETG on one continuous 5 kg spool, 0.6 mm nozzle, approx 0.28 mm layers. Preferred total slicer mass <=3 kg; hard planning ceiling <=4 kg including support/brim. Multi-pack of 1 kg spools does not meet requirement.","M4 through-bolts, washers and metal nuts for primary structure; M3 metal standoffs and machine screws for boards. No structural self-tapping screws into PETG.","Primary GPU load goes into padded body supports and bracket restraints, then reinforced rails/feet. Do not let the PCIe socket carry the card's mass. Four-card totals are 4.8/8.8 kg before PSU; these are test loads, not certified chassis ratings.","measurements_template.json status is PENDING_PHYSICAL_MEASUREMENTS. All printer actual_model, usable_build_volume, receivers exact_sku/pcb_size/mounting_hole_xy/hole_diameters/underside_keepout_z/slot_datum/connector_keepouts, cards A-D sku/dimensions/mass_kg/safe_support_patches/power_connector_keepout/vendor/vram_mib/maximum_board_power_w/auxiliary_power_connectors/receiver_sku/host_branch_mapping, psu sku/body_dimensions/cable_inventory/connector_service_volume/intake_exhaust_keepouts, host branch_mappings A-D, and print_release orientation/brim_footprint/model_mass_kg/support_brim_mass_kg/spool_mass_kg/load_test_pass/thermal_test_pass are null.","SVG layout_3plus1_concept.svg shows exact GPU envelope rectangles (compact 170 W x 168 H x 199 D; universal 254 W x 245 H x 360 D) with twelve millimetre gaps. Dashed printed-core bounds and suggested load paths are concept constraints, not modeled structural members. SVG footer states ALL SUPPORT / RECEIVER / CABLE INTERFACES UNMEASURED — NOT CAD / FIT PASS.","No packing study below establishes a complete chassis fit. Unknown receiver, clamp, base/roof, cable and PSU envelopes can invalidate a promising card-box arrangement. The integrated four-card layout is pre-CAD; no final fit, CAD or production STL is released."],"geometry_failures_or_unknowns":["Actual usable build volume of Ender-3 S1 Pro is null pending measurement; nominal 220x220x270 cannot be assumed to yield the 200x188x254 conservative box with brim/support clearance.","Compact 3+1 pack arithmetic (170x199x168 mm) leaves only 84 W / 1 D / 20 H remainder before unknown interfaces; this is a bottleneck, not spare integration room. Base/roof/support thickness, receivers, power/signal connectors, bends, PSU, fans/plenum and removal/tool volumes are excluded from this math and remain unresolved.","Universal 3+1 pack (254x360x245 mm) exceeds recovered 188 H installed orientation by 57 mm. Tall alternative (188W x 200D x 254H) leaves only 9 mm height reserve beyond 245 H GPU-only pack before floor/roof/receiver allowances.","Upper support contact location for Card D cannot be invented from an outer box; no orientation alone proves this layout fits. Support footprints within the narrower core are not yet proven.","Serial fan + plenum depth (249–259 mm) requires 49–59 mm installed rear projection beyond 200 D core bound before other clearances. Receiver/cable intrusion into this space is UNKNOWN.","Intake throat of 12 mm must be preserved after every interface intrudes; longitudinal staggering saves width only where card bodies actually cease overlapping, which is unverified.","PSU body dimensions, restraint geometry, airflow keepouts, connector service volumes, and native cable inventory are null. Cable bend radii and safe support patches are uninvented.","Receiver PCB mounts remain slotted until official CAD or caliper measurement supplies hole centers, underside components, connector heights and slot datum. Both published CAD links failed during collection.","PETG layer anisotropy creep means broad metal washers/spacers and modest clamp pressure are required; printing in tall orientation needs layer-direction load review after part rotation. Junction reinforcement against layer separation is unmodeled.","Foot stability/torque overhang check with heaviest population (up to 8.8 kg plus PSU) is unperformed. Center of gravity shift from authorized GPU overhang is uncalculated.","Independent removal sweep volumes for all four cards (including lower cards exiting without removing D) are unmodeled. Static fit vs removal sweep is not validated.","Four-card simultaneous thermal load and airflow distribution are untested. Free-air CFM is not chassis airflow; adding a fan does not prove revised plenum fits or cools correctly.","Slicer mass pref <=3 kg and hard <=4 kg including brim/supports on one fresh continuous 5 kg spool is unverified because model_mass_kg and support_brim_mass_kg are null.","Shared headers constraints and actual measurements remain null; no fake FITS_PASS or certified load rating
